product_name.quote: Policy Document- Bharti AXA Life Wealth Pro

irdai_description_line.value: A Unit Linked, Non-Participating Individual Life Insurance Plan
irdai_description_line.quote: A Unit Linked, Non-Participating Individual Life Insurance Plan

value.name: Growth
value.description: policy terms 10/15/20/25/30 years; maturity includes Return of Mortality Charges, Return of Premium Allocation Charges and Wealth Boosters

value.name: Legacy
value.description: cover to age 99 (policy term 99 minus entry age), 10 x annualised premium; Loyalty Additions and Wealth Boosters; SWP available

variants_or_plan_options.quote: Growth Variant: Maturity Benefit payable shall be equal to the Policy Fund Value (including Return of Mortality Charges, Return of Premium Allocation Charges and Wealth Boosters) as on the date of maturity.

target_segment_stated.note: brochure describes goals (house, education, wedding, retirement) but names no target segment

online_offline.value: both (separate online and other-channel allocation charges)
online_offline.quote: The allocation charge is as per the tables below: For Online Channel:

entry_age_min.value: Growth: 8 yrs (PT 10), 3 yrs (PT 15), 91 days (PT 20/25/30); Legacy: 91 days

maturity_age_max.quote: 75 years for Growth Variant 99 years for Legacy Variant

policy_term_options.value: Growth: 10, 15, 20, 25, 30 years; Legacy: 99 minus age at entry
policy_term_options.quote: In this Variant the policy term op ons available are 10, 15, 20, 25 and 30 years with mul ple Premium Payment term op ons.

ppt_options.value: Growth: single, 5, 7, 10, 15 years or regular (by PT); Legacy: 5, 7, 10 years or to age 60 (no single pay)
ppt_options.quote: Single Pay op on not available for Legacy variant.
ppt_options.note: full PT x PPT grid on brochure p.3

premium_min_annual.value: Rs 1,200 (limited/regular, both variants, online and other channels)
premium_min_annual.note: brochure does not say whether Rs 1,200 is per instalment or per year

premium_max.value: no limit, subject to board-approved underwriting policy
premium_max.quote: No Limit, subject to Board Approved Underwri ng Policy

sum_assured_rule.value: Regular/limited: 10 x annualised premium. Single pay (Growth): Option 1 125% of single premium or Option 2 10 x single premium, by age and term (Option 2 only up to age 50/46/43 for PT 10/15/20)

premium_modes.quote: Premium Payment modes available under the Policy are annual, half yearly, quarterly and monthly.

life_cover_multiple_choice.value: only for single pay Growth: 1.25x or 10x single premium; regular/limited fixed at 10x
life_cover_multiple_choice.quote: Option 1: 125% * Single Premium Option 2: 10 * Single Premium

premium_allocation_charge.quote: The Company will levy an Allocation Charge as a percentage of the Annualised Premium.
premium_allocation_charge.note: returned at maturity in Growth variant (RoPAC)

policy_administration_charge.quote: The Policy administration charge is subject to a maximum of Rs 500 per month.

fund_management_charge.quote: The above charges (except for Discontinued Policy Fund) will not exceed the maximum cap prescribed by IRDAI which is currently 1.35% p.a.

mortality_charge.value: per 1000 sum at risk per annum by attained age, deducted monthly; full table published in the policy bond; rates guaranteed for the term; 3-year setback for female lives
mortality_charge.quote: The rates of mortality charges are guaranteed to remain the same during the policy term.
mortality_charge.note: table on policy bond p.14; returned at maturity in Growth variant (RoMC)

value.single: separate table on policy bond p.15 (single premium up to / above Rs 3,00,000)

discontinuance_charge.quote: The Discontinuance Charge shall be levied at the time of Surrender or on Discontinuance of Premium whichever is earlier.

switching_charge.quote: The Policyholder is entitled to make any number of Switches in a Policy Year free of charge.

partial_withdrawal_charge.quote: In a Policy Year, the Policyholder is entitled to make any number of Partial Withdrawals free of charge

premium_redirection_charge.note: premium redirection is allowed after year 1 (p.7); no charge is stated

rider_charges.note: riders are paid by additional premium (brochure p.10); deduction from fund not stated

any_charge_returned.value: Growth variant: all mortality charges (excluding extra mortality and taxes) and all premium allocation charges returned at maturity as units; not on surrender, discontinued or paid-up policies
any_charge_returned.quote: RoMC and RoPAC shall not be credited in case of Surrender, Discontinued or Paid-up Policy.

death_benefit_formula.value: highest of: sum assured less partial withdrawals in the 2 years before death; 105% of premiums paid; fund value (incl. loyalty additions)
death_benefit_formula.quote: The Death Benefit will be highest of: 1. Sum Assured* less Partial Withdrawals made in the two-year period immediately preceding the date of death of Life Insured. 2. 105% of all premiums paid as on date of death.

maturity_benefit.value: fund value (Growth: incl. RoMC, RoPAC, wealth boosters; Legacy: incl. loyalty additions, wealth boosters); settlement option available
maturity_benefit.quote: At maturity, the Policyholder may also choose to avail of the Settlement Option.

loyalty_additions.value: Legacy only: 0.75% of fund value at the end of each year from year 10 to one year before maturity
loyalty_additions.quote: Loyalty Additions will be credited to the Policy at the end of each Policy Year starting from the end of tenth Policy Year till one year before the date of maturity.
loyalty_additions.note: not credited after the policy becomes paid-up

wealth_boosters_or_guaranteed_additions.value: both variants: 0.25% of fund value at end of year 5 and 1.25% at maturity (Growth: 1.25% of fund value before adding back RoMC and RoPAC)
wealth_boosters_or_guaranteed_additions.quote: Wealth Booster will be credited to the Policy at the end of fifth policy year and at Maturity date.

return_of_mortality_charges.value: Growth only: 100% of mortality charges deducted, at maturity
return_of_mortality_charges.quote: Return of Mortality Charges (RoMC) and Return of Premium Allocation Charge (RoPAC) (Applicable only in Growth Variant)

return_of_premium_allocation_charges.value: Growth only: 100% of premium allocation charges deducted, at maturity
return_of_premium_allocation_charges.quote: Return of Mortality Charges (RoMC) and Return of Premium Allocation Charge (RoPAC) (Applicable only in Growth Variant)

return_of_policy_admin_charges.note: only mortality and allocation charges are returned

fund_switching.value: unlimited free; minimum 5% of fund value in any allocated fund
fund_switching.quote: The Policyholder is entitled to make any number of Switches in a Policy Year free of charge.

premium_redirection.value: allowed after the first policy year
premium_redirection.quote: can be modified only after the first Policy Year by submitting the Investment Fund Allocation Instruction.

partial_withdrawals.value: after the 5-year lock-in; minimum Rs 5,000; fund value must stay at least 120% of one annualised premium (25% of single premium); not before the minor life insured is 18
partial_withdrawals.quote: i. The minimum partial withdrawal limit is Rs 5,000.

systematic_withdrawal_plan.value: Legacy only: annual SWP from year 10, up to one annualised premium per year, minimum Rs 5,000 per instalment; can opt out once
systematic_withdrawal_plan.quote: SWP (Systematic Withdrawal Plan): is an automated partial withdrawal facility which can be opted by the Policyholder under Legacy Variant.

top_up_premiums.note: policy bond and brochure do not mention top-ups

settlement_option.value: fund value as lump sum, instalments over up to 5 years after maturity, or a combination; apply 90 days before maturity
settlement_option.quote: Settlement Period is the period not exceeding five years commencing from the date of maturity and is an option available to the Policyholder at maturity.

policy_loan.quote: 12. Loan There is no provision of loan on the Policy.

value.name: Dynamic Fund Allocation
value.mechanics: premiums go to Grow Money Plus Fund; over the last 5 years funds move to Steady Money Fund (80/20, 75/25, 70/30, 50/50, 0/100); inception only; can opt out once

value.name: Systematic Transfer Plan
value.mechanics: annual premium goes to Safe Money Fund, then 1/(13 - month) of units move monthly to Grow Money Plus Fund; annual mode only; no switch charge

auto_portfolio_strategies.quote: At inception of the Policy, the Policyholder may also choose to allocate the premium/s in one of the Investment strategies as per the conditions of the Product, with a maximum of two Investment strategies being available.

fund_count.value: 8 funds plus the Discontinued Policy Fund
fund_count.quote: The Investment Funds currently offered under the Policy by the Company are - Growth Opportunities Plus Fund, Grow Money Plus Fund, Save’n’grow Money Fund, Steady Money Fund, Safe Money Fund, Build India Fund, Stability Plus Money Fund and Emerging Equity Fund.

fund_list.quote: Growth Opportunities Plus Fund SFIN: ULIF01614/12/2009EGRWTHOPPL130
fund_list.note: SFINs, allocations and risk labels from policy bond p.10; FMCs from p.13

index_or_thematic_funds.value: Build India Fund (infrastructure theme), Emerging Equity Fund (mid cap); no index fund
index_or_thematic_funds.quote: To provide long term capital appreciation through investing in a portfolio of mid cap companies

critical_illness.quote: For added protec on, the following riders can be availed by paying addi onal premium along with Bhar AXA Life Wealth Pro.

accidental_death.value: Bharti AXA Life Linked Complete Shield Rider (130A012V02)
accidental_death.quote: Bhar AXA Life Linked Complete Shield Rider 130A012V02

value.name: Bharti AXA Life Linked Complete Shield Rider

riders_available.quote: Bhar AXA Life Linked Complete Shield Rider 130A012V02
riders_available.note: rider table on brochure p.10; check it for further riders

lock_in_years.quote: p) Lock-in Period is a period of five years from the Date of Commencement of Risk.

discontinuance_rules.value: in lock-in: fund less discontinuance charge moves to the Discontinued Policy Fund (4% p.a. minimum), cover stops, proceeds paid after lock-in; after lock-in: policy becomes reduced paid-up unless revived or withdrawn
discontinuance_rules.quote: The proceeds of the discontinued policy shall be refunded only upon completion of the lock-in period.

revival_period.value: 3 years from the first unpaid premium
revival_period.quote: kk) Revival Period is the time of 3 years from the date of the first unpaid premium

surrender_value_rule.value: in lock-in: fund value less discontinuance charge, paid after year 5; after lock-in: total fund value
surrender_value_rule.quote: Upon complete withdrawal of the policy after five policy years, the Total Fund Value as on the date of complete withdrawal, shall be payable and the Policy shall terminate

documents_inventory.note: fund information is a web page, not a document
fund information is a web page, not a document

new_features_not_in_schema.description: Growth returns mortality and allocation charges at maturity; Legacy instead pays loyalty additions and covers to age 99
new_features_not_in_schema.quote: ii. Legacy Variant: Maturity Benefit payable shall be equal to the Policy Fund Value (including Loyalty Additions and Wealth Boosters) as on the date of maturity.

new_features_not_in_schema.feature: Policy ends if fund value falls below one annualised premium after lock-in
new_features_not_in_schema.quote: If at any time after the Lock-in Period, the Fund Value falls below at least one Annualized Premium, the Policy shall stand terminated.

new_features_not_in_schema.feature: Mortality rates guaranteed for the term
new_features_not_in_schema.description: the published mortality table cannot change during the policy term
new_features_not_in_schema.quote: The rates of mortality charges are guaranteed to remain the same during the policy term.
